candidates.title: SARA: SLO-Aware Resource Allocation for Disaggregated Agentic LLM Services
candidates.reason: Queueing-theoretic prefill/KV-transfer/decode resource models and cost-constrained SLO allocation directly extend disaggregated serving, KV transfer, and goodput optimization lineages.

candidates.title: Fast Recovery for LLM Serving via Decoupled Device Memory Lifetime in Dynamo
candidates.reason: Dynamo recovery preserves GPU-resident model state across engine failures through decoupled device-memory ownership, directly relevant to inference runtime reliability and persistent accelerator memory.

candidates.title: DLB: Distributed Load Balancing at Scale for Generative AI Inference
candidates.reason: DLB targets heterogeneous, multi-stage generative-inference service times with distributed load balancing, directly updating large-scale serving scheduling and SLO-aware routing.

candidates.title: Unified AI Gateway: A Framework for Joint Model Routing and KV Cache Management
candidates.reason: The gateway jointly coordinates model routing with KV-cache availability and compatibility, directly connecting routing decisions to cache reuse and recomputation costs.

candidates.title: PrefixBench-H100: Characterizing Prefix Reuse and Time-to-First-Token in H100 LLM Serving
candidates.reason: Controlled vLLM/TensorRT-LLM measurements characterize when KV prefix reuse improves TTFT and when scheduling/cache pressure erodes benefits, directly relevant to prefix caching and serving-runtime comparisons.
